title: P256 G512 grouped early abort with receiver-side hash join, both-pair reuse, carried emission, ZVA zeroing

claims.statement: For the protected full-production P256 target, the cold classical algorithm in proof.md and supporting documents recovers the scalar with probability at least0.39 using expected total work at most81492681352162551951261317074842456930642 scalar instruction equivalents, below2^125.938010011267580 group units at C1000; per-run work at most the disclosed worst case in proof.md section15. q1=377464334,q2=2^28,N=2^70,G=512 groups. The run executes contiguous X-row groups in lockstep (per-group hop1 slots of5*2^17 records; a resident receiver that appends each record to one cumulative home record array and joins it at arrival into hash chains keyed by K2 mod2^60 with a packed next-array and uncapped walks; per-group resolution) and halts at the first group whose resolver confirms [x]P=Q (latched stop flag); the expectation charges each group's per-row and per-record work (arithmetic, emission, driver, both hops including the receiver's append and hash insert) and its main-pair hash walks (history-conditional pair counting) times a Chen-Stein prefix non-stopping bound; same-row walks, K2 verifications and defective walks are charged globally without that bound (a listing costs no more than the walk advance it replaces), and the per-group fixed work of all512 groups, the phase-4 stages, generation, sampling, normalization, the full carry meter cap and all caps, failures, preprocessing, resolution, verification, barriers, control and output at their worst case. Includes construction, normalization, range-tree control, capped carry/failure costs, fixed block-window transport with hop1 transaction-bound ACK and hop2 DONE-flag completion (the receiver is charged 15 for every potential record: an accepted record costs 15 including the append and hash insert, a full-array drop 7; walks cost 6 per chain visit and 4 per K2 match, charged by pair counting), hash-head zeroing, resolution, verification and output. Peak memory below2^136bytes; preprocessing below2^119units included; no advice or auxiliary powers. Analytical bound under the stated ideal-coin blocking-port machine, not production execution or formal certification. Retained from the base: DONE markers with STLR signaling awaited via the barrier LDAXR/WFE primitive, the receive window released only by the final flag load after all five packet words are in registers, both-pair first-operand reuse in the backward pair, TBZ/BFI inline emission (2489/4 per incidence, +1 per flush firing), the2^24 candidate cap with its Markov loss and q1 re-searched least; the intruder row uses the182-bit chain-match rate.

experiments.purpose: Check direction/carry-specialized assembly, descriptor invariants, the grouped hash-chain transport replay and the exact E-ledger.
